posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Yeah, the game actors have in initMembers this._lastBattleSkill  = new Game_Item(); and it's only set in Scene Battle onSkillOk. So your conditional just keeps returning true if you've used a skill. Show how you tried using another property and the action and someone can help you better.

posts.author: ColinTornada
Robro33
posts.body:
the notetags looked fine to me so i tested them in a project and and had no issue with it as is. did you save your project after setting the notetag? the changes wont actually be reflected ingame until you do. other than that, did you set up a console.log() to check what the lastSkill is and what the ID is when the issue happens?
also as a note, you might have to change the priority of your states. the action end effects are ran in order of highest to lowest priority and then highest to lowest id. so if the state the notetag is in is below 298 and is the same prioprity, affected battlers will never have 298 by the time the other state checks for it

posts.body: Only thing that came to my mind is that did you check that your attack skill id is 1 (since it's repeating)? Doesn't explain the weird change when using different states though.
